participant_id.Description: BIDS participant label (zero-padded to match allContacts_MNIcoords.csv)

source_id.Description: Participant label used in the Dryad file names

age.Description: Age in years as listed in Sherman et al. (2023) J Cogn Neurosci 35(8):1312-1328, doi:10.1162/jocn_a_02012, Methods Table 1 ("Patient Demographics and Electrode Placement"); paper patient ID N = release participant sub-N = BIDS sub-0N (mapping verified against the release electrode files, see README). Not given in the Dryad release itself. Cohort (paper): 8 patients, age range 21-61 years, mean 37.8 years.

sex.Description: Sex as listed in Sherman et al. (2023) J Cogn Neurosci 35(8):1312-1328, doi:10.1162/jocn_a_02012, Methods Table 1 ("Patient Demographics and Electrode Placement"); paper patient ID N = release participant sub-N = BIDS sub-0N (mapping verified against the release electrode files, see README) (paper: 'one woman'). Not given in the Dryad release itself.

handedness.Description: Handedness: not reported in the Dryad release nor in Sherman et al. (2023) (n/a for all participants).

implant_type.Description: Implant type from Sherman et al. (2023) J Cogn Neurosci 35(8):1312-1328, doi:10.1162/jocn_a_02012, Methods Table 1 ("Patient Demographics and Electrode Placement"); paper patient ID N = release participant sub-N = BIDS sub-0N (mapping verified against the release electrode files, see README). Table 1 note: 'Implant type indicates whether the implanted electrodes were only depth electrodes (depth) or a combination of depth electrodes and grid/strip electrodes on the cortical surface (combined).'

Levels.combined: depth electrodes combined with subdural grid/strip electrodes on the cortical surface

hemisphere.Description: Cerebral hemisphere into which the electrodes were implanted, from Sherman et al. (2023) J Cogn Neurosci 35(8):1312-1328, doi:10.1162/jocn_a_02012, Methods Table 1 ("Patient Demographics and Electrode Placement"); paper patient ID N = release participant sub-N = BIDS sub-0N (mapping verified against the release electrode files, see README) (wording of the paper, lower-cased).

n_contacts_paper.Description: Number of electrode contacts (nContacts) per Sherman et al. (2023) J Cogn Neurosci 35(8):1312-1328, doi:10.1162/jocn_a_02012, Methods Table 1 ("Patient Demographics and Electrode Placement"); paper patient ID N = release participant sub-N = BIDS sub-0N (mapping verified against the release electrode files, see README). The release files list slightly more contact labels per participant (the MNI coordinate file has 226/123/198/122/178/176/159/166 rows for sub-1..8, and channels.tsv has more EEG-type channels); the paper count is reported as published and the difference is not explained in the sources.
